results.sentence: NCT06993610 (Tibulizumab Skin Healing and Inflammation Evaluation for Lasting Defense) overall status is RECRUITING as of registry update 2025-08-12.
NCT06993610 enrollment is 180 (estimated) as of registry update 2025-08-12.
NCT06993610 primary completion date is 2026-09 (estimated) as of registry update 2025-08-12.
NCT06993610 is registered as PHASE2 as of registry update 2025-08-12.
NCT06993610 lead sponsor is Zura Bio Inc as of registry update 2025-08-12.
